# AFAS Brand Styling

## Overview

Apply AFAS Software's official brand identity and style resources to any artifact — presentations, web pages, social media graphics, e-mail templates, documents, and more.

**Keywords**: AFAS, branding, huisstijl, corporate identity, visual identity, styling, brand colors, typography, AFAS brand, visual formatting, visual design, PowerPoint, social media

## Brand Guidelines

### Writing the Name

- Always write **AFAS** in four capitals
- **AFAS Software®** is a protected trademark within the European Union
- The old logo with arches is **no longer used**
- The tagline "Inspireert Beter Ondernemen" is **deprecated**

### Logo Usage

| Variant | Usage |
|---------|-------|
| **Stacked logo** | Default (AFAS & software stacked) |
| **Inline logo** | Only when stacked logo doesn't fit (AFAS & software side by side) |

| Background | Logo version |
|------------|-------------|
| White | Logo in color (blue) |
| Dark | Logo in white |
| Light colored | Logo in black *(not preferred — consult marketing)* |

Logo must always appear in full color or white — no other color combinations.

## Typography

### Font Stack

| Font | Usage | Weights |
|------|-------|---------|
| **Roboto** | Headings, presentations, video, multimedia | Black (700) and Light (300); Regular only if needed |
| **Open Sans** | Body text on website | Regular (400) and Light (300) |
| **Inter** | AFAS Profit & InSite application UI | — |
| **Arial** | E-mail only (compatibility fallback) | — |

### Font Downloads

- Roboto: [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto)
- Open Sans: [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Open+Sans)

### Typographic Style Rules

- Alternate between **Roboto Black** and **Roboto Light** for headings — creates a playful yet powerful look
- Body text color: `#41474D` (dark gray)
- Hyperlinks: a lighter blue tint than AFAS Blue

### Website Typography Specs

| Element | Font | Size | Weight | Line height |
|---------|------|------|--------|-------------|
| Heading | Roboto Black + Light | — | 700 / 300 | — |
| Short intro | Open Sans Regular | 22px | 300 | 36px |
| Body text | Open Sans Regular | 15px | 400 | 25px |

---

## Presentation (PowerPoint) Rules

- Always use a **photo as background** when possible
- Text always **white** on a **blue overlay**
- Headings: **Roboto Black** at 36px
- Body text: **Roboto Light** at 24px
- Blue overlays: **10% transparency**
- Blue accent bar at bottom: **10% transparency**
- Use AFAS stock photos

---

## Social Media Rules

- Follow PowerPoint style direction
- Use an engaging photo with at minimum a **blue line in AFAS Blue**
- Blue line: **10% transparency** at the bottom of the image

---

## E-mail Rules

- Font: **Arial** (for compatibility across all mail clients)
- Use the standard AFAS mailing template
- E-mail signatures include profile photo and contact details

---

## Color Application Logic

When applying AFAS brand styles to artifacts:

1. **Backgrounds**: Use `#FFFFFF` (white) or `#F2F5F8` (extra light gray) for light backgrounds; `#1A1F24` (black) or `#005FAA` (AFAS blue) for dark backgrounds
2. **Primary text**: `#41474D` (dark gray) on light backgrounds; `#FFFFFF` (white) on dark/blue backgrounds
3. **Headings**: Roboto Black (700) — use AFAS Blue `#005FAA` on light backgrounds, white `#FFFFFF` on dark
4. **Accent elements**: Orange `#F59F39` for primary CTA/buttons; Green `#3CC658` for secondary/success actions
5. **Borders and dividers**: Light gray `#C3CBD3` or extra light blue `#D7EAFF`
6. **Non-text shapes/decorative elements**: Cycle through AFAS Blue, orange, and green accents

### Font Fallback Chain

| Context | Primary | Fallback |
|---------|---------|----------|
| Headings | Roboto | Arial |
| Body (web) | Open Sans | Arial |
| Body (app) | Inter | Arial |
| Body (e-mail) | Arial | — |

## Boilerplate Text

> Werk kan veel leuker en beter zijn, en met meer aandacht voor de maatschappij. In veel organisaties zijn mensen bezig met de verkeerde dingen. Onnodige taken, dubbel werk en fouten herstellen kosten veel tijd en zijn niet goed voor de kwaliteit. De missie van AFAS Software is: beter ondernemen inspireren. AFAS doet dit met software en alles wat nodig is om die software zo te gebruiken dat je er een hoger doel mee bereikt. Organisaties houden tijd over voor wat echt belangrijk is, zoals kwaliteit en plezier in het werk: Succes begint met AFAS.
